headline: Lull Broken as Fishermans Row, Tempest Island Trade Strongholds
war_summary: Since the previous edition the wires have come alive again. Fishermans Row and Tempest Island both logged a fresh round of stronghold transfers inside the past two hours, while Godcrofts stirred once more at Lipsia. Farranac Coast and Lykos Isle have gone quiet on the latest event sheet, but Lykos carries the day's heaviest count at twenty-four flips, and Farranac remains among the leaders at fifteen. Weathered Expanse, DeadLands, and Stlican Shelf remain stubborn killing grounds; Weathered Expanse has burned through tens of thousands of casualties without a single recorded change of ownership in the past day. On war day 113, with no side yet at the thirty-four victory towns required for conquest, the front is still undecided.
